Find rhymes in General American English: words and phrases that sound the same from the last stressed vowel on, but different just before it. Click a rhyme to look it up, or type a pronunciation between slashes, like /ˈhɛd/ or /'hEd/. The pronunciations are fetched online, but you can download them to use the page offline, or load your own (see the bottom of the page).

Type sounds in IPA or using: A ɑ father · a æ cat · ^ ʌ or @ ə cut · O ɔ caught · E ɛ bed · 3 ɝ/ɚ bird · I ɪ bit · i beat · U ʊ book · u boot · eI bait · aI bite · aU out · oU boat · OI boy · S ʃ ship · Z ʒ measure · tS chip · dZ judge · T θ thin · D ð this · N ŋ sing · j/y yes, others as usual. Put ' before the stressed syllable (by default the first) and , before a secondary one, e.g. /'m^Nki/ monkey.
